The background is dark and out of focus. The lighting appears to be from a direct flash, creating highlights on the skin and scales.

The very tip of the snout exhibits a slight 'melting' or softening effect where it meets the background/focus plane, which is inconsistent with the sharpness of the eye just millimeters away.

To audit the structural integrity of the human hand holding the snake, checking for finger fusion, unnatural joint angles, or missing digits which are common AI artifacts.
To check for edge bleeding or fusion between the snake's scales and the human skin, ensuring they are distinct topological entities.
